paragraphs: Flashpoint sells threat intelligence to businesses and government organizations, combining primary-source collections from adversary spaces with analyst expertise and integrated AI. The company reports access to over 3.6 petabytes of threat intelligence drawn from open and hard-to-reach adversary spaces. Corporate customers use it to uncover stolen credentials, fraud schemes and ransomware, and to combat financial fraud, account takeovers and brand abuse.

A unit called Flashpoint National Security Solutions serves defense, law enforcement and government agencies with open-source intelligence, investigative support and finished intelligence. Those teams can get direct access to the Flashpoint Ignite platform, Echosec for geospatial OSINT and Managed Attribution for secure digital operations. Agencies that prefer their own tools can instead take the data through REST APIs or a Firehose stream, or lean on managed services such as bespoke requests for information and multilingual analysis.

Flashpoint states that all of its activities align with U.S. laws and comply with Department of Justice guidelines on data collection from illicit sources. It also describes itself as GDPR, CCPA and EU Privacy Shield compliant. The company says its team spans 8 countries with 35+ languages spoken, and it lists large North American financial institutions and Fortune 10 companies among those who rely on it.

quote.text: Flashpoint provides the most comprehensive OSINT solutions today to support the different needs of the National Security market globally.
